messages:
Sam (Sales): Quick sync — Globex POC. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC role mapping, and domain proofing for tenant-lock. Also asking Dedicated vs Private pricing; decision due EOD Wed. Any immediate blockers?

Alex (SE): On SAML we support IdP-initiated + SP-initiated. Need ACS URL + EntityID from Globex, nameID format, and the group claim key to map to RBAC. :+1:

Maria (Security): Heads up — security questionnaire flagged: required SAML assertion signing algos, SCIM over TLS enforcement, SCIM auth (prefer OAuth2 token), and data retention/erasure policy. Legal will want answers before Private deployment.

Sanjay (Eng): For POC we can do SCIM delta sync but note rate limits (50 req/min default). Dedicated connector can run in their VPC for Private deployments. If they push groups via SCIM, we need mapping rules from their group object to our role names. Quick SCIM example payload we send during tests: ```json
{ "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"], "externalId": "employeeId", "userName": "jdoe@globex.com" }
```

Julie (Billing): We can offer a short POC discount for 30 days. For a Dedicated reservation quote I need expected monthly tokens and active user counts. Can someone confirm rough numbers?

Sam (Sales): Rough estimates from the prospect: ~500 MAUs, ~3M tokens/mo at POC peak. They also request an SLA for auth-related latency.

Alex (SE): SLA note — on Dedicated we can target 95th percentile auth routing latency ~200ms. For Private on-prem we'll need a short network checklist: firewall allowlist, outbound control-plane ports, and cert exchange. I'll paste a minimal checklist now.

Alex (SE): Checklist:
- Provide ACS URL & EntityID
- Exchange signing & TLS certs
- SCIM base URL + token (scoped)
- TXT record for domain ownership (tenant lock)
- RBAC mapping table (their groups -> our roles)

DeployBot: dedicated-connector/v2.1 deployed to staging — SCIM connector tests: passed ✅

Maria (Security): One blocker: legal wants confirmation of SCIM data residency (EU-only customers require EU-hosted Private). If Globex is EU-bound we need region-specific Private plan.

Sam (Sales): Can @Julie and @Alex prepare a quote + the minimal SAML/SCIM docs by EOD? I'll book a 30-min sync with Globex tomorrow 10am PT.

Julie (Billing): On it — will pull a draft quote and include POC discount line items.

Alex (SE): Will assemble the config snippets and checklist, and request their IdP metadata.

Sam (Sales): Great — thanks everyone. I'll follow up after the sync. :thumbsup:
